entities.summary: Duan Yongping is a Chinese-American billionaire entrepreneur and electrical engineer. He was the director of the Subor Electronics Industry Corporation and founded BBK Electronics Group. Duan's net worth was estimated at $1.5 billion, according to the 2018 Hurun China Rich List.
